frozen_before: new ROC-04 source case generation and any ROC-04 model fitting
scientific_question: At fixed model, context skeletons, eight-row task loss, initialization, and optimizer exposure, does training on 512 distinct A-rule permutations rather than four improve unseen A-rule table accuracy and correct legal binding-edit response?

source.original_roc02_sealed_policy: Do not load, materialize, evaluate, relabel or select with original ROC-02 family 6/7 examples.
source.exclude_all_original_roc02_rules: Exclude all 8 known original ROC-02 affine tables from new high-diversity, dev, reserved rule pools. Low-four arm alone uses original previously exposed ROC-02 train rule tables 0-3.
source.universe: all 8! = 40,320 bijections of values 0..7, lexical list shuffled with Python random.Random(seed=20261117079); exclude eight original ROC-02 affine tables before shuffle
source.allocation: after exclusion/shuffle: indices [0:512) train, [512:768) development, [768:1152) reserved future; no rule-table identity overlaps across high-train/dev/reserved
source.high_train_table_assignment: table pool index i modulo 512, exactly two examples per table in fixed schedule (train order shuffled with fixed independent seed)
source.low_train_table_assignment: one of the four original already exposed ROC-02 source family tables 0-3, index i modulo 4
source.temporal_skeleton: identical train schedules, final query, distractor events, delay and their tables in both arms; only A rule binding and exact answer differ
source.distractor_tables: original exposed ROC-02 training family tables 0-3, identical across both arms
source.dev_examples: 256 distinct unseen A-rule permutation tables, one example per table; may use their labels to inspect registered development outcomes
source.reserved_test: reserve deterministic table IDs only, do not create examples, inspect labels or tune on them in ROC-04A
source.permutation_identity: sha256 of canonical compact 8-integer table list
source.source_identity: sha256 canonical JSONL bytes of emitted train-low4, train-high512, and dev files; report all SHA, family/multiset count, unique records and no table collisions
source.exact_oracle: independent symbolic_execute(events), plus direct A-table lookup agrees for every case

model.final_query: visible 8-way onehot selecting row of 8x8 table logits; final query excluded from memory updates
model.objective: 8-class task CE + 0.5 * full eight-row table CE
model.initial_weights: identical within each seed, seeded torch.manual_seed(seed)
model.paired_sampler: same per-seed shuffled case index streams, generated with torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed+20261116)
model.source_usage: train cases only for gradient steps, dev cases only for reported milestones; no early stopping or dev selected checkpoint

analysis.primary: at the exactly fixed 1920th update, dev unseen-permutation task accuracy of high512 minus low4, six model seeds
analysis.primary_success: positive paired improvement in at least five of six seeds, mean improvement ≥0.20 absolute accuracy, and one-sided exact sign-flip p≤0.05 over 64 sign flips; report failure if any criterion fails
analysis.competence_gate: high512 dev task accuracy ≥0.70 in ≥5/6 independent seeds and dev complete 8-row table exact accuracy ≥0.50 in ≥5/6 seeds; otherwise FAIL
secondary: model error by A-rule and query index
dev legal query-preserving table-row-swap counterfactual correctness
dev prediction invariance under label-preserving B/C distractor edits where available
analysis.legal_counterfactual: for each dev case swap permutation rows at queried q and (q+4)%8 in the initial source-A binding, leaving other events and query unchanged; symbolic oracle must change label; measure new-label accuracy and jointly correct original/swap count
analysis.distractor_control: where at least one B/C distractor is present, replace that event's table with a different known low-four A-unrelated table, keep answer unchanged; record prediction stability and accuracy
analysis.inference_unit: six independent paired model seeds, dev cases paired within each seed; 256 distinct rule tables do not create 256 independent model replicates
analysis.statistical_test: enumerate 64 sign assignments to six per-seed accuracy differences; one-sided exact p. No additional unregistered testing or seed selection
analysis.all_results: per-case dev original/swap/distractor CSV, train and dev milestone receipts, split source SHA, model and optimizer checkpoint hashes, exact sign-flip tally, honest nonparametric limits
analysis.scope: ROC-04A development-family feasibility; prospective sealed ROC-04B test is outside this stage and requires post-fit model/protocol lock

resources.hosted: six independent GitHub Actions matrix jobs; no paid GPU
resources.do_not_use: original sealed ROC02 family6/7 inputs or reserved ROC04 unseen-test cases

stop_conditions: source hash mismatch or duplicate active table across high/dev
original ROC02 sealed family6/7 source file read
unequal initial weights or sampler order
